component.name: AirPC
component.summary: Stream games and other applications from another PC running Sunshine or GeForce Experience

description.p: AirPC can stream games and other applications from another PC with Sunshine or GeForce Experience software installed.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and NVDEC support
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support
Gamepad support with force feedback for up to 16 players
Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)
Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host
